Name: Furniture Adjustment
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you move individual furniture pieces and wall-hangings in four directions.

To move a piece of furniture, hover over it with the mouse, then press one of the hotkeys.

Default hotkeys are:

[list]
[*]Move Up: [b]NumPad 8[/b]
[*]Move Down: [b]Num Pad 2[/b]
[*]Move Left: [b]Num Pad 4[/b]
[*]Move Right: [b]Num Pad 6[/b]
[/list]
Pressing these keys shifts the furniture by one pixel. If you hold down a mod key (default [b]Left Alt[/b]), it shifts it by an increased amount (default [b]5[/b] pixels).

You can edit all the config variables using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, or editing the [b]config.json[/b] file.

See also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10217]Furniture Recolor[/url] for changing color of individual furniture pieces.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], doesn't use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
